        About The Station

        Who We Are

        NAU FM is Papua New Guinea's biggest youth radio station, broadcasting on 96.3 FM out of Port Moresby. Projecting from the Highlands to the Islands, we bring the latest global and local hits to listeners from as young as 15 to 25 — high energy, trend-setting, and always on the pulse of what's next.

        From sunrise drive-time to late-night vibes, our on-air crew keeps the biggest hits and best entertainment running around the clock — plus community news, call-ins, and the tracks everyone's talking about.

        Born and raised in Port Moresby, Sherry joined NAU FM straight out of high school after winning a station talent search. Three years on air later, she's known for her rapid-fire trivia segments and an uncanny ability to guess a caller's request before they finish dialling in.
